_comment: Committed fixture embeddings (D15 / PLAN §5 Q0): a small DETERMINISTIC 8-dim embedding per fixture doc so `truffle index --hybrid` exercises the BM25 + fixture-vector -> RRF fusion path with ZERO embed-API calls in CI. NOT a real model output — hand-authored interpretable concept vectors. The 8 axes are: [0]=kubernetes/orchestration, [1]=gpu/hardware, [2]=windows-error-code, [3]=auth/security, [4]=docker/containers, [5]=memory-pressure/eviction, [6]=disk/storage, [7]=general-infra. The live embedder (OpenAI 3-small) is the additive Wave-V run only; the fusion+ranking machinery is identical with these vectors. Vectors are roughly L2-normalised so cosine similarity is well-behaved.
